en: Colorized photograph of a sandy beach with sunbathers in swimsuits lying on towels. Behind them is an outdoor café or kiosk with red‑and‑white sun umbrellas and tables. Two tall flagpoles prominently display blue flags with a yellow Nordic cross (the Swedish flag). The scene is surrounded by dense coniferous forest under a clear blue sky, giving a relaxed summer‑holiday atmosphere typical of a lakeside or seaside resort.
